title: Lava Vision Enchantment
description: add an enchantment to make you see clearly in lava
body:
Lava Vision

This mod introduces a new enchantment book called Lava Vision, which can be applied exclusively to helmets. When worn, the enchanted helmet allows you to see clearly through lava – removing the usual murky, orange-tinted obstruction and granting you full visibility underwater in the Nether or any lava pool. Whether you're hunting for ancient debris, exploring underwater ruins, or simply navigating dangerous volcanic areas, Lava Vision turns a blinding hazard into a crystal‑clear window.

The enchantment works seamlessly in both singleplayer and multiplayer environments, and is fully compatible with other helmet enchantments. No configuration is required – just enchant your helmet and dive right in.

Let me know if you'd like to add any additional details, such as enchantment levels, rarity, or incompatibilities.
